canonical_string:
METHOD
path
timestamp
nonce
base64url(SHA-256(exact body bytes)) — joined with single 
, no trailing newline

headers.X-Hotline-Nonce: fresh per request; base64url, 8–64 chars; replay-checked per room over 300 s
headers.X-Hotline-Signature: base64url (no padding) of the 64-byte P1363 r||s, low-S MANDATORY

intent: Signed-header vectors for the core-v1 control plane (SPEC §3.1). Scheme is verbatim hotline-push-gateway PROTOCOL.md §1–2 / internal/app/pushsign.go. Verifiers MUST accept vectors[] and reject every case in reject[] with the named code. Signers are validated by sign→verify roundtrip plus the mandatory low-S assertion (ECDSA is randomized, so signer output is not byte-comparable).

reject.name: high-s
reject.note: the malleable twin s' = n - s of the valid register signature; verify must enforce low-S explicitly

reject.name: tampered-body
reject.note: same headers/signature, body bytes changed → body hash mismatch

reject.name: wrong-path
reject.note: signature bound to path via canonical string

reject.name: stale-timestamp-past
reject.note: 301 s after the signed timestamp; window is ±300 s inclusive

reject.name: replayed-nonce
reject.note: presenting the exact register vector a second time within 300 s of the first must be rejected

rules.key_lookup: no X-Hotline-Key-Id header: the verifying key is reg.box_pub for the room named in the path; first register is TOFU
